Questions people ask

When should we bring you in?+

As soon as the release is defined. The earlier the positioning and GTM brief are agreed, the less rework there is for sales and marketing later. I can also step in mid-launch to rescue a plan that’s drifting.

How do you work with our sales team?+

Sales is part of the plan from day one. I talk to reps about the objections they hear, build the enablement kit with them, and check after launch which assets they actually used.

How do you measure whether a launch created pipeline?+

We agree the measures before launch: sourced and influenced pipeline, demo requests, sales usage of launch assets and early adoption. Then I report against them after launch, using your CRM and analytics.

Can you run one launch, or only a launch program?+

Both. A single launch is a fixed-scope project. For teams that ship often, I run the launch program as an embedded partner and leave you a repeatable playbook.

Which regions do you cover?+

I work from Lagos with teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa, and I’ve run launches in both English and Arabic.
